title: On prime endomorphisms of the free group of rank two
summary: We study prime endomorphisms of the free group $F_2$. The main results provide lower and upper bounds for the logarithmic density $δ_{\mathrm{np}}$ of non-prime endomorphisms: $$ \frac34 \leq δ_{\mathrm{np}}\leq \frac{27}{28}. $$ Equivalently, we prove corresponding lower and upper bounds for the exponential decay of the probability that a random endomorphism is non-prime, aligning with a heuristic argument of Ian Agol.
